messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm queuing a release for lane C at 16:00 PT today. Need someone to own smoke + rollback readiness. Should be a light rollout: model swap + small config tweak. Who can take smoke?
Priya: I can take smoke. I'll be on laptop and available. Planning a 15:55 preflight run.
Sam: I can own rollback if we need it. Which image/model tag are we pushing?
Alex: Pushing rwd-model:v2026-03-18-clip. If smoke fails we'll roll back to v2026-03-11. Sam, can you pre-assert the rollback job and keep the PR ready?
Maya: Quick Q — Dedicated pool headroom? I saw a small spike earlier on GPU util. Might affect canary.
ops-bot: Autoscaler report — Dedicated pool 'redwood-dedicated-c' at 78% GPU utilization, no scale-up pending.
Priya: Smoke checklist I'll run at 15:55 PT:
```
1) ./scripts/smoke -n lane-c --samples 50
2) watch /console/releases/lane-c (errors & 5xx)
3) validate latency p95 < 250ms and no p50 regressions
4) confirm token billing metric increments roughly in line with sample size
```
Priya: ETA for canary start 16:00, canary traffic 5% for 2 min, then 25% at 16:04 if green.
Sam: Rollback job confirmed — tag v2026-03-11 exists in registry and infra runbook references rollback-script.sh. I'll open a quick PR to exercise the rollback path and hold it for handoff.
Alex: @Jordan (oncall-sre) can you watch net ingress + node OOMs during the canary window (16:00-16:10 PT)? Minor flapping last night made me cautious.
Jordan: Will monitor dashboards and start a watch at 15:50 PT. I'll post alerts here if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
Priya: Launch plan recap: 15:55 preflight smoke, 16:00 start canary (5%), 16:02 run smoke check, 16:04 increase to 25% if green, 16:08 full rollout if still green. I'll mark the train slot as claimed. Ping me in this thread when ready.
Alex: Thanks all — adding to the release train. Rollout owner = Priya, rollback owner = Sam, SRE = Jordan. Saving this thread as the deploy record for lane C.
